verdict.rationale: Missive publishes an llms.txt index at /docs/llms.txt, and its content (docs-71 to 74) has been retrieved, which corroborates it. Every docs page is also served as raw Markdown by appending .md, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. The root-level /llms.txt and /docs.md probes returned 404, but that only hurts discoverability; it doesn't contradict the documented /docs/llms.txt path. Missing for 10: llms.txt at the conventional root path (probe 404), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and any documented agent-specific guidance beyond the index and Markdown pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
